Step 2: Gathering Relevant Information
To create effective documentation, it's essential to gather relevant information from reliable sources. Some popular sources include:
Pokémon Lore (https://pokemonlore.com/types) The Pokémon Type Chart provides a comprehensive overview of all 18 types in the Pokémon universe, detailing their strengths and weaknesses against each other. This information is invaluable for trainers looking to build balanced teams and strategize effectively during battles. Example: A developer working on a Pokémon-themed game can use this chart to understand how different types interact with each other and create more effective strategies.
Bulbapedia (https://bulbapedia.bulbagarden.net/wiki/Type) Bulbapedia offers a detailed breakdown of type effectiveness across different generations. Key points include: Different types of moves have varying effects against different types of Pokémon. For example, a Fighting-type move used against a Psychic/Flying Pokémon is mostly ineffective, while a Grass-type move used against a Water/Flying Pokémon deals regular damage.
